body:
Tested locally on Linux with an Xbox Elite Series 2 controller, I noticed 2 issues on [Control Gallery (3.x)](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/3.x/gui/control_gallery):

- Using the up D-pad while on the first item on a PopupMenu won't go to the last item, even if you hold it for a long duration. In contrast, it works if you use the down D-pad while on the last item. It will also work if you use the up D-pad while on the second item, and wait long enough for repeat to start.
- This is printed when using the D-pad on a Slider for the first time:

```
WARNING: Prefer InputEvent.is_action_pressed() within input event callbacks to prevent detecting duplicates.
     at: is_action_just_pressed (./main/input_default.cpp:116)
```
